briefing.bottom_line: Infosys is generating strong new business with large deal wins up 28% and AI growth at 29%, but this is offset by very slow underlying revenue growth of just 1-2% and a structural risk from its suspension from the US Green Card program. The company remains financially healthy with minimal debt and a plan to return most of its cash to shareholders, but margins are expected to stay flat due to wage pressures.
